statements.statement: The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The patient reports recent episodes of transient neurological deficits suggestive of a transient ischemic attack (G45.9)
The service is for continuous rhythm assessment to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias
The denial reason code is CO-22
The denial is based on care may be covered by another payer per coordination of benefits regulations
The service is medically necessary to identify arrhythmias contributing to the patient's embolic risk
